# Benchmarks — construction, annotation, splits (R1-1, R1-8, R1-14)

## Files (generated by `generate.py`, seed 0)
- `queries.jsonl` — 150 NL queries, 30/category (count/find/track/action/filter).
  Each: `qid, category, text, relevant [clip ids], video_id, time_bucket`.
- `alert_utterances.jsonl` — 120 utterances (60 clean + 60 stress:
  ambiguous/conflicting/missing/unsupported).
- `person_pairs.jsonl` — 50 calibration pairs, identity-disjoint placeholder.
- `splits.json` — 50 tune / 100 test stratified split (qid suffix ≤10 tune).

## Annotation protocol
1. Queries authored from live-clip observations (zone/time/attribute/action).
2. Relevance = clip contains the answer; for counting the clip must contain the
   true count (P@5 measures supporting-clip retrieval; EM/MAE complementary).
3. Current labels are synthetic placeholders so eval runs offline. Replace
   `relevant`/`expected_*` with dual-annotator labels; report Cohen's κ and
   adjudication, then re-run `backend/scripts/eval_*.py`.
4. Calibration pairs must be logged by identity+camera+time with no overlap to
   eval galleries (currently placeholder ids).

## Schemas
- `../app/eval/metrics.py` — P@5/R@10/F1@10=H-mean/macro-mean/EM/MAE.
- `alert_schema.json` — 9-tuple rule schema (in this folder).
- `nlfilter_schema.json` — query filter schema pointer.

## Release
Packaged for release; regenerate with `python backend/benchmarks/generate.py`.
